flavor.phonemic_palette: Old English: retain w-; au>ea, ai>a; th retained; weak -a/-e endings; -ingas kin-names; Norse-overlay -r, -by, -son among the sea-raiders; theophoric stems are the Chaotic-power reflexes (Mearox-, Waecid-, Lusand-).
flavor.phenotype_notes: Synthesis of Norse + Anglo-Saxon per setting-lore §5.3 (blend the listed features; exclude the inverse).

magic_attitude.notes: Norse + Anglo-Saxon register; deity-morphs in name_bank 'cwealmingas'.

religion_hooks.alignment_lens: Resolved per the culture's chosen alignment (setting-lore §4.2): Lawful venerates the 12 Lawful powers and names the 13 as demons; Chaotic venerates the 13 and names the 12 as tyrant-gods; Neutral venerates this culture's ancestral saints, invoking the great gods only situationally.

flavor_text.one_line: Cwealmingas — xenophobic clan confederation of the dense forest; strength, glory.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Cwealmingas (Norse + Anglo-Saxon) are a expansionist clan confederation people seeded in dense forest, forest, swamp. They prize strength, glory, cunning, lean toward the military sphere, and field berserkers, heavy_infantry, marines. Outsiders are met as xenophobic; their patrons touch war, death, night.
